reviews.title: I LOVE THESE WIRELESS FANS (Lian Li > Every other brand)
reviews.comment: Lian Li is so far ahead of every other brand and its not even close!!! These are by far the best case fans on the market right now, they look super clean with bright colors and have a sleek modern design that really brings your pc to life! The LCD screen is really awesome and can be controlled individually to make some pretty cool images/videos. The Lian Li L-CONNECT3 software also has sensors so you can track your temps in real time and display them on the LCD screen. The fans daisy chain together so they are super easy to install and the wireless aspect gets rid of that mess of cables most case fans come with and all of your RGBs are controlled by a USB stick that plugs in to the back of your motherboard. The wireless technology is really the future and they killed it with how easy it is to use. I will NEVER go back to non wireless again! The connectors on the fans also have a great build quality and don't feel cheap like some other brands! The fan speed is fully customizable with their software and they are by far the most quiet fan available at the moment. These things can also move some air! My CPU and GPU stay super cool while under load because of these things I really cannot express how much I love these fans! Keep up the good work Lian Li <3
reviews.author: Tommy

reviews.title: Reliable Fans from a Trusted Brand -Efficient and maiby Q+uiet
reviews.comment: I bought four of these fans-three as intake to keep the GPU radiator clean, and one as exhaust to remove air from my chassis- and they have been performing perfectly so far. They are very quiet, provide excellent airflow, and installation was straightforward. I hope they continue to work just as reliably over time. Highly recommended for anyone needing efficient cooling solutions -even at the higher cost, they’re worth it. One recommendation: the RPM is slightly lower than the TL model without a screen. If you plan to use them on radiators, they should be rear intake fans or run at higher speeds, which will result in more noise. For example, I placed the original GPU fans on the back of the radiator, as shown in the pictures. Note: the back fan is a regular one, while the others have reversed blades for intake to the PC.
reviews.author: Felipe Aguirre

reviews.title: TERRIBLE PRODUCT
reviews.comment: Absolute nightmare. Quality control on these fans is awful. I ordered 6 reverse blade and 2 regular and more than half of the reverse blades are dead. I have searched the internet for every FAQ and troubleshooting guide out there. I tried them all and they are 100% dead. I proceed to do an RMA process and a new nightmare begins. Customer service with Lian Li just tries to sweet it under the rug as everyone who buys them is incompetent and it's all user error. They give the same generalized troubleshooting info that every other page does. Hopefully if I cant get them RMA'd then I'm just going to return them all and go with another fan. It really sucks because the LCD was a big part of my build.
reviews.author: David Anthony Humphries
